findings.summary: BookingSuccessScreen countdown timer may navigate into detached state
findings.detail: The 10-second setInterval in BookingSuccessScreen calls navigation.navigate('HomeTab') on expiry. If the user navigates to BookingDetails first, the screen may remain mounted in the stack (gestureEnabled:false prevents back-swipe but not forward navigation), causing a second navigate call when the timer fires. Fix: add a navigation.isFocused() guard inside the interval callback before calling navigate.

findings.summary: Admin client cannot mark confirmed bookings as rescheduled
findings.detail: AdminBookingDetailsScreen.VALID_TRANSITIONS.confirmed is ['in_progress', 'cancelled'] but the server's ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS.confirmed includes 'rescheduled'. An admin cannot trigger the confirmed→rescheduled transition from the mobile app even though the API supports it. Fix: add 'rescheduled' to VALID_TRANSITIONS.confirmed in AdminBookingDetailsScreen.

findings.summary: CustomerHomeScreen fetches up to 20 bookings to display 3
findings.detail: CustomerHomeScreen calls bookingService.getMyBookings() with no params on every focus event, fetching the default page of 20 bookings just to render 3. Fix: pass { limit: 5 } or a status filter to scope the request.

findings.summary: getISTDayName depends on full ICU data in Node.js runtime
findings.detail: availabilityService.getISTDayName uses toLocaleString({ timeZone: 'Asia/Kolkata' }) which requires full ICU data. The default Node.js binary ships with small-icu; on minimal Docker images, day-of-week resolution may fall back silently and break workingDays filtering. Verify ICU data is present in the deployment environment.
